prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE full-bleed landscape 3:2 finished children’s-book illustration, no text or panels.
STYLE LOCK: closely match the soft expressive animated children’s-book forms in references 1 and 2. Warm cream facial planes, open readable hazel/amber iris around separate pupil, broad gentle eyelids, rounded appealing muzzle, grouped sculpted fur. Papa is a mature broad adult about 1.6 times PinPin height, NOT the child duplicated at same scale. Dog shoulder about 2.7 child heights, warm dark-brindled brown, white chest bib, grey-cream muzzle, folded triangular ears, curled rump tail. Dog expression attentive and emotionally present. No black button eyes, dark face masks, hard shiny skin, photographic animal anatomy/detail or live-action fur. All unclothed animal characters. Only Elder has glasses.
REFERENCE ROLES: Image 1: PRIMARY Elder and PinPin identity/style reference; exactly these two hedgehogs; Image 2: AUTHORITATIVE book style, Elder and PinPin identity, expressive iris/pupil eyes, soft animation shapes; Image 3: ENVIRONMENT GEOGRAPHY ONLY; root portal, left staff/boulder and path, right fern, sunny patch beyond fern.
NARRATIVE AND CAMERA: A close two-shot at PinPin’s eye height. The Elder has turned away from Papa and bent toward the child, silver-quilled expressive face and gold round glasses at right, PinPin’s curious cream face/chestnut quills at left. True reciprocal pupil alignment: Elder gazes DOWN-LEFT into PinPin eyes; PinPin looks UP-RIGHT into Elder eyes. Their faces and small forepaw gestures carry the image, root-door background softly recedes. Elder two open gentle paws; child two paws relaxed near belly. Papa is standing nearby OFFSCREEN LEFT speaking his introduction; dog also offscreen. No large looming adult, no duplicate father, no labels. Natural invitation to conversation.

This is a cinematic story moment, not a character-sheet montage.
